brief: Identify the separate costs of a cash advance in a fictional card agreement.

title.pt-BR: Saques a crédito têm termos próprios

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Cash Advances"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Adelantos tienen términos propios"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Saques a crédito têm termos próprios"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Identify the separate costs of a cash advance in a fictional card agreement.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: A cash advance can carry its own fee and interest rule; do not copy purchase terms without checking the agreement.
instruction.misconception: A cash advance inherits all purchase grace terms or its only cost is the withdrawal fee.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Identify cash received, the advance fee and when interest starts. The agreement may treat advances differently from purchases.
The advance has both separately stated costs.
The borrowing cost combines the fee and supplied interest.
The supplied advance rule starts interest on the transaction date.
Both supplied charges add to the borrowing cost.
The fee alone does not determine the missing interest cost.
Different transaction rules require separate cost checks.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
